**[critical · security]** SQL query built from request input

`parse()` returns a new object; the caller keeps using the old one, so config edits are lost.

**Fails when:** calling load() twice → the second call sees stale defaults

```suggestion
const rows = await db.query('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = $1', [id]);
```

<sub>found by claude+codex · confidence 0.95 · blocking</sub>
